_doc: SAS language-coverage set (S-4): exercises detect / scan / split-points, including the macro-heavy case that defeats AST and the staging-reclassification case.

macro_heavy.sas.notes: Dataset names emitted by the macro processor; static scan cannot fully resolve outputs — the LLM pass is expected to improve on this.

staging_reclass.sas.notes: work.staging is written then read back in the same program -> reclassified Output -> Intermediate.
